source.quote: The Board approved a quarterly Class A dividend of US$1.4625 per share payable on October 20, 2026
The combined ratio improved by 13 points to 103.9% in Q2 2026, down from 116.9% in Q2 2025
lifting management fee revenue for policy issuance and renewal services 4.7% to 862,879
Erie Indemnity reported second-quarter 2026 earnings of $3.45 per share, topping Wall Street's estimate of $3.35
